Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Artoo & •Threepio]]: R2-D2 with his computer arm plugged into a socket of the Death Star's computer network in ''Star Wars''. Through the network he finds Princess Leia's cell and shuts down the garbage mashers.

Source: [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:Artoo_plugged_in_ANH.png Artoo plugged in ANH.png], Wookieepedia (a frame from ''Star Wars'' (1977); 1920 by 816 pixels). Reduced to 800 by 340 pixels and converted to JPEG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20241204171314/https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/starwars/images/c/cf/Artoo_plugged_in_ANH.png/revision/latest Internet Archive], 4 December 2024 (the image file).
